notes: Fixes a bug that lost your lessons. Android's own backup restores Corlang when you reinstall or change phone, and it was bringing back your profile but not your progress: your name was there and your lessons were at day 1. The database was being saved under one file name while the newest rows were still sitting in a second file that was never saved. Everything now lives in the file that gets backed up. If a reinstall has already reset you, import the backup file you exported from Settings and your progress comes straight back.
